name: @aion/career-input
description: Owner-controlled career input contracts and non-ingesting preflight

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aion/object && npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/object && npm run build --workspace @aion/privacy-boundary && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js"
scripts.test:preflight: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/preflight.test.js"
scripts.test:templates: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/templates.test.js"
